response: I get mad when people are unfair, act with inconsideration, or break promises.

When people are unkind or inconsiderate, it makes me mad. When people are wasteful or unethical, it makes me mad. When people treat others unfairly or disrespectfully, it makes me mad. When people are insincere or dishonest, it makes me mad. When people are hurtful or hateful, it makes me mad. When people take advantage of others, it makes me mad.

When people are not honest, when things don't get done on time, when people are unfair, when people are inconsiderate, when people are mean, when there is a lack of respect, when people don't follow through with their word, when people take advantage of others, when things are done carelessly.
Injustice and hatred make me mad.
I get mad when I see people treating others unfairly or not acting with respect. It is unacceptable when people take advantage of others or do not take responsibility for their actions.
I get mad when I see injustice or when people are treated unfairly. I also get mad when I see people taking advantage of others or acting in a unethical manner.
Injustice, intolerance, and cruelty make me mad.

Injustice, inequality, and unfairness make me mad. Seeing people take advantage of others, or being treated unfairly, or not getting an opportunity that someone else got just because of a random factor like race or gender, gets my blood boiling. I also get angry when people are mean or unkind for no reason, or when someone is cruel to animals.
I get mad when I see injustice or when people don't take responsibility for their actions.

I get mad when I see unfairness or injustice. I also get annoyed when people don't take responsibility for their actions or when they are inconsiderate of others. I also get frustrated when things don't go the way I want them to or when people don't listen to me. I guess what makes me mad is human nature!

When people are dismissive or disrespectful, I get mad. When someone isn't honest or trustworthy, I get mad. When people abuse power, take advantage of others, or hurt innocent people, I get mad. When things don't seem fair or equitable, I get mad. When people don't listen or try to understand, I get mad.
I get mad when I see injustice, whether it's in the world or in myself. I also get annoyed when people are unkind or disrespectful, especially when they aren't aware of it.
I get mad when people treat others unfairly. I also get angry when people are not truthful or when I see prejudice and discrimination.
Injustice, unfairness, and lack of respect make me mad. When people are treated unfairly or treated badly, it really angers me.
When people are dishonest or don't follow through on commitments, that really gets my goat.
Injustice, inequality, and people playing the victim card make me mad.
Injustice, cruelty, and negligence make me mad.
When people are not considerate of others, when people are dishonest, when injustice is done, when good people are treated unfairly.

When people are inconsiderate or disrespectful, it makes me mad. When someone speaks over me or doesn't take my opinion into account, it drives me up the wall. I also get frustrated when people aren't honest with me or take advantage of me.
When people are not honest or act unkindly, it makes me mad.
